items.question: What services does XFLEX offer?
items.answer: XFLEX offers a comprehensive range of professional services including Taxation Services (VAT & Corporate Tax), Auditing and Assurance, ESR & UBO Compliance, Administrative and Business Consultancy, and Accounting & Bookkeeping.

items.question: Do you help with VAT registration and filing in the UAE?
items.answer: Yes, we provide end-to-end VAT services, including registration, deregistration, return preparation, and filing. We also represent clients before the Federal Tax Authority (FTA) to ensure smooth compliance.

items.question: Can you manage my company's bookkeeping and payroll?
items.answer: Absolutely. We offer monthly bookkeeping, payroll processing, WPS compliance, financial reporting, and reconciliation to ensure your records are accurate and audit-ready.

items.question: Are your auditing services approved for official and regulatory use?
items.answer: Yes, our auditing services are conducted in accordance with international standards and are suitable for statutory requirements, free zone compliance, and licensing renewals in the UAE.

items.question: What’s the difference between your pricing plans?
items.answer: Our plans are designed for different business stages: 'Essential Compliance' covers basic tax setup; 'Growth & Monitoring' handles ongoing monthly filings; and 'Tax Protection & Advisory' provides full-scale risk management and advisory support.

items.question: Do you help with company setup in the UAE?
items.answer: Yes, we specialize in business setup and licensing across UAE Mainland, Free Zones, and Offshore jurisdictions, providing all necessary consultancy and PRO services.

items.question: What is ESR and UBO compliance, and do I need it?
items.answer: ESR (Economic Substance Regulations) and UBO (Ultimate Beneficial Ownership) are mandatory regulatory frameworks in the UAE. Most businesses need to assess their status and file notifications or reports; we provide full support for these filings.

items.question: Do you offer one-time services or only monthly subscriptions?
items.answer: We offer both. You can engage us for one-time projects like VAT registration or corporate tax setup, or opt for our monthly retainer plans for continuous accounting and tax support.

items.question: How do I get started with your services?
items.answer: The easiest way is to book a free consultation through our website. Our experts will assess your business needs and provide a tailored proposal to get you started immediately.
